summary: Phase P0.2.A LocalizationRuntime™ regression — green end-to-end. Backend pytest 22/22 (100%) at /app/backend/tests/test_locale_runtime.py covers: GET /api/locale-runtime/resolve chain (tenant default, explicit override, project signal via PROJECT_EN_AE, lead signal via LEAD_FR_FR), browser-Accept-Language is correctly WEAK and does NOT override tenant default IT_IT, all 7 supported locales (IT_IT/EN_US/EN_GB/EN_AE/DE_DE/FR_FR/ES_ES) resolve to a profile with non-empty system_brief, unknown XX_XX locale falls back with ':fallback' suffix in source, cross-tenant project_id and lead_id from MOOD Demo Studio passed by a Showroom user produce candidates.project=None and candidates.lead=None (NO LEAK), PUT /api/locale-runtime/preference persists EN_GB and next resolve returns source='user', PUT preference with XX_XX returns 400, PUT /api/locale-runtime/tenant-default succeeds for super_admin (200) and is correctly blocked for designer (403), tenant-default with XX_XX returns 400, GET /api/locale-profiles still returns all 7 profiles (P0.6.G regression intact). Frontend Playwright on /dashboard validated: IT_IT (tenant default) renders eyebrow='Operazioni di studio' + Italian welcome, switching preference to EN_AE flips data-locale-code='EN_AE' + eyebrow='Atelier operations' + welcome='Curate the next signature experience for your client.', EN_GB flips to 'Studio direction' + 'A quieter, more considered project direction is emerging.', and a hard page reload preserves the EN_AE preference (resolves from persisted users_profile.preferred_locale_code). All 7 explicit locale resolves return the correct {language,market,locale_code} via the LocaleRuntimeProvider.
action_items: (Pre-existing, NOT introduced by P0.2.A) React console warning during dashboard render: 'A props object containing a key prop is being spread into JSX' — somewhere downstream of OperationalHero a list maps with spread {...item, key: id} instead of explicit key= prop. Cosmetic but spams the console.

(Pre-existing) Initial dashboard mount fires ~4 background fetches BEFORE the Bearer token is applied → flurry of 401s in console immediately after login; once the token attaches, all calls succeed. Consider gating the first AuthenticatedShell layout queries behind `token != null` to silence the noise.

(Optional) The Projects page H1 header 'Progetti' is hard-coded Italian and does NOT pass through runtime.copy() — only the empty-state ([data-testid='projects-empty-*']) was refactored per spec, which is correct for P0.2.A scope but worth flagging for the next phase (P0.2.B) when the rest of the workspace shell should be localized.

(Optional) The Market Perspective AI smoke test was skipped — endpoint shape uses POST /api/proposals/{pid}/perspective rather than /api/market-perspectives/switch. The smoke could be wired explicitly to the real endpoint, but main agent already validated all 3 AI engines (Strategic EN_AE, Compose EN_GB, Market DE_DE) produce locale-native prose.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/core/locale_runtime.py is 362 lines and tightly cohesive — no split needed. The market-intent-preserving FALLBACK_CHAIN dictionary is exactly the right shape; the only minor concern is that EN_AE → [EN_GB, EN_US] is hard-coded and not data-driven via locale_profiles. If a new market is added (e.g. EN_SG), the chain must be code-edited rather than seeded. Consider moving FALLBACK_CHAIN into locale_profiles.fallback_to[] column.

resolve() makes 4 sequential Supabase round trips (user/project/lead/tenant) on EVERY locale-runtime/resolve call — every page load on the frontend triggers 1 resolve, so this is on the hot path. Two of the four queries can be parallelised, or a single users_profile join could fetch users_profile + tenant default + project locale in one round trip (denormalised). Today the call returns in <250ms on the preview env, so not a P0, but watch as projects scale.

/app/backend/routers/locale_runtime.py PUT /preference does NOT verify the user's profile_id is non-null before the .eq('id', None) update — if a guest session somehow reaches the endpoint, it would no-op silently. Add `if not ctx.get('profile_id'): raise 401` guard.

PUT /tenant-default role list `('super_admin','studio_owner','owner','admin')` is slightly permissive — 'admin' is not a documented role in the credentials playbook; either remove it or document it. Designer correctly receives 403 in testing.

with_runtime_prompt() silently uses empty strings for missing profile fields — if a locale_profiles row is partially seeded (e.g. emotional_style missing), the AI prompt will contain 'EMOTIONAL STYLE:  ' (blank line) which dilutes cultural conditioning. Add a runtime assertion or seed-test that every active locale_profile row has all 8 cultural fields populated.

Frontend LocaleRuntimeProvider mount in App.js is positioned inside the auth tree — correct — but the first /api/locale-runtime/resolve request still races with login (visible as a 401 flash in console). The provider should defer its initial resolve() until session.access_token is non-null.

success_rate.backend: 100% (22/22 non-slow tests passed; 1 AI smoke skipped because endpoint path differs)
success_rate.frontend: 100% on tested flows (IT_IT default, EN_AE switch, EN_GB switch, hard-reload persistence, all 7 explicit locales)

seed_data_creation: None. Tests rely on the existing seeded PROJECT_EN_AE=i18n-recovery-1 and LEAD_FR_FR=i18n-recovery-1. User preference is reset to IT_IT at the end of every flow to avoid polluting downstream tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use /app/backend/tests/test_locale_runtime.py as the canonical regression suite for Phase P0.2.A whenever locale_runtime.py, the routers, or with_runtime_prompt() are touched. The test file resets user preference to IT_IT at the end of TestPreference.test_set_preference_persists_and_wins and again at end of TestTenantDefaultRBAC.test_super_admin_can_set — so module-level order matters (preference tests must run AFTER the chain tests to keep `tenant`/`browser` signals isolatable). When testing AI engines under runtime, use the real endpoint paths: POST /api/projects/{pid}/strategic-direction/generate (was tested as POST /api/{pid}/strategic-direction inside ai_studio_brief router but namespace is /api/projects), POST /api/proposals/{pid}/perspective (market perspectives), and POST /api/projects/{pid}/compose-proposal (proposal composer). The locale_code parameter is passed in the JSON body or via X-Locale header per engine. Frontend tokens are stored at localStorage['mfd_session'].access_token — use this for any direct API calls from a logged-in Playwright session.
rca of the issue: No P0/P1 bugs found in scope. Phase P0.2.A — LocalizationRuntime™ is functionally green across backend chain, RBAC, tenant isolation, fallback semantics, and the frontend Dashboard hero data-locale-code + copy switch + persistence-across-reload contract. The console warnings observed (key-prop spread, 401s on cold mount) are pre-existing React/auth-mount issues unrelated to this phase.
